description: This file implements a SQL-based job store for managing background jobs in the Mattermost server, including methods for saving, updating, retrieving, deleting, and cleaning up jobs, with support for optimistic concurrency and JSON data handling.

classes.name: SqlJobStore
classes.description: A struct that manages SQL operations for job entities, including methods for CRUD operations and cleanup.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new job record into the database.

methods.name: SaveOnce
methods.description: Attempts to save a job only if no pending or in-progress jobs of the same type exist, using a transaction.

methods.name: UpdateOptimistically
methods.description: Updates a job's status and data with optimistic concurrency control based on current status.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a job by ID.

methods.name: UpdateStatusOptimistically
methods.description: Atomically updates job status and timestamps, returning the updated job.

methods.name: GetAllByTypesPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of jobs filtered by multiple types.

methods.name: GetAllByType
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs of a specific type.

methods.name: GetAllByTypeAndStatus
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs of a specific type and status.

methods.name: GetAllByTypePage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of jobs filtered by type.

methods.name: GetAllByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs with a specific status.

methods.name: GetAllByTypesAndStatusesPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of jobs filtered by multiple types and statuses.

methods.name: GetNewestJobByStatusAndType
methods.description: Retrieves the newest job matching a specific status and type.

methods.name: GetNewestJobByStatusesAndType
methods.description: Retrieves the newest job matching multiple statuses and a specific type.

methods.name: GetCountByStatusAndType
methods.description: Counts jobs matching a specific status and type.

methods.name: GetByTypeAndData
methods.description: Retrieves jobs of a specific type matching specific JSON data key-value pairs, optionally using master database.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Deletes old jobs based on expiry time and batch size, with retries.
